seo.title: Names: repository, package and pkg-config | OpenMixer
seo.description: The repository, pkg-config, RPM, DEB and npm name of every OpenMixer piece you can use on its own.

hero.title: Names: repository, package and pkg-config.
hero.lede: One row per piece. Use it to find the package that holds a piece, or the repository behind a package name.

table.title: One row per piece.
table.intro: A dash means the piece does not ship in that form.

suffix.title: How a built package is numbered.
suffix.text: Packages built from our own sources carry no suffix (0.15.1-1). A package we rebuild from another project's source carries omx after its release counter, so it never takes the place of the distribution's own build: 0.1.0-7~omx as a DEB, 11.2.omx in an RPM's release.
